title: Virtual Screening Strategy to Identify Retinoic Acid-Related Orphan Receptor gammat Modulators.
authors: Jokinen, Elmeri M; Niemelainen, Miika; Kurkinen, Sami T; Lehtonen, Jukka V; Latti, Sakari; Postila, Pekka A; Pentikainen, Olli T; Niinivehmas, Sanna P
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦RORgammat小分子抑制剂的虚拟筛选与分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-配体结合建模，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Molecular docking is a key method used in virtual screening (VS) campaigns to identify small-molecule ligands for drug discovery targets. While docking provides a tangible way to understand and predict the protein-ligand complex formation, the docking algorithms are often unable to separate active ligands from inactive molecules in practical VS usage. Here, a novel docking and shape-focused pharmacophore VS protocol is demonstrated for facilitating effective hit discovery using retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor gamma t (RORgammat) as a case study. RORgammat is a prospective target for treating inflammatory diseases such as psoriasis and multiple sclerosis. First, a commercial molecular database was flexibly docked. Second, the alternative docking poses were rescored against the shape/electrostatic potential of negative image-based (NIB) models that mirror the target's binding cavity. The compositions of the NIB models were optimized via iterative trimming and benchmarking using a greedy search-driven algorithm or brute force NIB optimization. Third, a pharmacophore point-based filtering was performed to focus the hit identification on the known RORgammat activity hotspots. Fourth, free energy binding affinity evaluation was performed on the remaining molecules. Finally, twenty-eight compounds were selected for in vitro testing and eight compounds were determined to be low muM range RORgammat inhibitors, thereby showing that the introduced VS protocol generated an effective hit rate of ~29%.
abstract_zh: 分子对接是虚拟筛选（VS）活动中用于识别药物发现靶点小分子配体的关键方法。尽管对接提供了一种切实可行的方法来理解和预测蛋白质-配体复合物的形成，但在实际VS应用中，对接算法往往无法区分活性配体与非活性分子。本文展示了一种新颖的对接和形状聚焦药效团VS方案，以维甲酸受体相关孤儿受体γt（RORgammat）作为案例研究，以促进有效的命中发现。RORgammat是治疗炎症性疾病（如银屑病和多发性硬化症）的潜在靶点。首先，对商业分子数据库进行柔性对接。其次，根据镜像靶点结合腔的负像（NIB）模型的形状/静电势，对替代对接姿态进行重新评分。NIB模型的组成通过迭代修剪和基准测试进行优化，采用贪心搜索驱动算法或暴力NIB优化。第三，进行基于药效团点的过滤，将命中识别聚焦于已知的RORgammat活性热点。第四，对剩余分子进行自由能结合亲和力评估。最后，选择28个化合物进行体外测试，其中8个化合物被确定为低微摩尔范围的RORgammat抑制剂，从而表明所引入的VS方案产生了约29%的有效命中率。
